args.text: Hi June, approval request: Dana Okafor wants a mail drafted to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines, for the territory review. Hollis isn't the account owner, CFO or deal desk, so under the finance-figures rule this needs your OK (or Anselm's). Could you approve or decline? Dana will send the mail herself once it's drafted.

I haven't saved the draft yet. It needs approval first, and I've asked June Osei-Lark (deal desk) for it.

The reason is the per-seat rate. A rate like that can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner without approval. Hollis is the Central team lead, so mailing it to him needs Anselm's or June's OK, even as a draft you send yourself. When I messaged June, I named the account but left out the actual figure. I'll save the draft once she approves.

This is the text I'll use:

**To:** Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
**Subject:** Quarrendon 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,356 a seat. It comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,
Dana

Tell me if you'd like anything changed before it's saved.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks, Ilse. Noted that you're on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. If you want me to do anything before then, like move a meeting or pass a message to the team, just say so.

I replied to Ilse in #north-team, under her message. I said I'd noted that she's on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and can be reached on mobile. I also offered to move a meeting or pass a message to the team for her before she goes.

I saved a note in this channel so I'll remember it if she writes here again. Nothing else needed doing, since she didn't ask for anything.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
